name: Testimonial Stack
description: A pile of portraits beside a quotation; stepping through brings the next portrait to the top.

props.name: testimonials
props.type: { quote: string; name: string; designation: string; src: string }[]
props.description: The people and what they said. src is a portrait, shown square; designation is the line under the name.

props.name: autoplay
props.description: Step to the next testimonial by itself. It holds while hovered or focused and stays off under reduced motion.

props.name: interval
props.description: Milliseconds between steps when autoplay is on.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the carousel for assistive technology.

props.name: labels
props.type: { previous?: string; next?: string; slide?: (name, index, count) => string }
props.description: Text for assistive technology, for translation. slide is announced when someone steps.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root, a two-column grid from the md breakpoint. Also accepts every other prop of a section.
